lines.en: : Wow. It’s really coming down, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哇。雨下得真大啊，是不是？

lines.en: : I thought it was supposed to be sunny today?
lines.zh: : 我还以为今天应该是晴天呢？

lines.en: : We’ll have to give that weatherman a piece of our minds, won’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们得好好找那个天气预报员算算账才行，对吧？

lines.en: : When do you think it will stop?
lines.zh: : 你觉得雨什么时候会停？
: 我不确定。
: 也许永远不会停？

lines.en: : Let’s have a talk, shall we?
lines.zh: : 我们聊聊吧，好不好？

lines.en: : You don’t need to respond or anything. I’ll handle all of the heavy lifting since you seem pretty tied up at the moment.
lines.zh: : 你不用回应什么的。既然你这会儿被绑得动弹不得，说话的活儿就全由我来吧。

lines.en: : I hope you’re having a nice week. Good things are pretty hard to come by in these parts, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 希望你这一周过得不错。在这一带，好事可是相当难得的，对吧？

lines.en: : So, let’s see here...where should I begin?
lines.zh: : 那么，让我想想……该从哪儿开始呢？

lines.en: : Well, first thing’s first, it’s not very polite to touch things that don’t belong to you. And it’s {i}especially{/i} not polite to try guessing somebody else’s password.
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先，动不属于自己的东西是很不礼貌的。而{i}尤其{/i}不礼貌的，是去试着猜别人的密码。

lines.en: : What if I had some really weird stuff on my computer that made you change the way you look at me forever?
lines.zh: : 万一我电脑里有什么很奇怪的东西，让你从此看我的眼神都变了呢？

lines.en: : I don’t, of course. I’m a good girl. And the only person I’ll ever have any attraction to sleeps right next door to my room, so I’d get nothing out of looking up inappropriate videos anyway.
lines.zh: : 当然没有了。我是个好女孩。而且我这辈子唯一会被吸引的人，就睡在我房间隔壁，所以去搜什么不合适的视频，我也捞不着好处。
: 嗯……还有什么……还有什么？

lines.en: : Oh! There was a caterpillar on the door when I came home the other day. That was an interesting thing that happened.
lines.zh: : 哦！前几天我回家的时候，门上有只毛毛虫。那算是件挺有意思的事。

lines.en: : I took some pictures. Do you want to see?
lines.zh: : 我拍了几张照片。你想看看吗？
: 不想？为什么？

lines.en: : Wow. That’s really interesting. I had no idea you felt that way.
lines.zh: : 哇。真有意思。我完全不知道你是这么想的。

lines.en: : So anyway, I’ve been thinking — you and I have known each other for a while now, and I think it’s about time I’m given a more important role in your life.
lines.zh: : 总之呢，我一直在想——你和我也认识挺久了，我觉得是时候让你在我的……不，是让我在你的生活里扮演一个更重要的角色了。

lines.en: : Yes, I {i}know{/i} my role is already important. But I think there’s a lot I can do that I haven’t been able to show you yet.
lines.zh: : 是，我{i}知道{/i}我的角色已经很重要了。但我觉得还有很多我能做的事，一直没能展示给你看。

lines.en: : And yeah, some of that is because you spend most of your time on people who aren’t me- but I’m starting to think that’s just because I’m not {i}appealing{/i} to you the way I’m supposed to.
lines.zh: : 而且没错，有一部分是因为你把大部分时间都花在了不是我的人身上——但我开始觉得，那只是因为我没有以我该有的样子{i}吸引{/i}到你。

lines.en: : Contrary to what many people believe, {i}I{/i} am the main heroine here after all.
lines.zh: : 和许多人以为的不一样，{i}我{/i}才是这里的第一女主角。

lines.en: : I’m the first one that shows up. The first one that falls in love. And I’ve held your hand through a billion different scenarios.
lines.zh: : 我是第一个出场的。第一个坠入爱河的。而且在无数个不同的剧本里，都是我牵着你的手走过来的。

lines.en: : You’d be nowhere without me, whether you want to believe that or not. But sometimes, it feels like I don’t get the recognition I deserve.
lines.zh: : 没有我，你什么都不是，不管你信不信。可有时候，我感觉自己没有得到应得的认可。

lines.en: : So, every once in a while, I think we should have a nice little heart-to-heart like this.
lines.zh: : 所以，我觉得我们偶尔也该像这样，好好来一次掏心掏肺的谈心。

lines.en: : Just to see if there’s anything one of us is doing that the other doesn’t approve of. Or something we think the other should change.
lines.zh: : 就为了看看，我们之间有没有谁做了对方不认同的事。或者有什么是我们觉得对方该改的。

lines.en: : Here. You can start. What’s something about me you want to change?
lines.zh: : 来。你先开始。我身上有什么是你想改的？
: 没有？真的？

lines.en: : Oh, come on. There’s gotta be {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。总该有{i}点什么{/i}吧。

lines.en: : Heheh! Now you’re just being a goober!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿！你现在就是个傻鹅！

lines.en: : But, listen — there’s something about {i}you{/i} that I want to change.
lines.zh: : 但是，听着——{i}你{/i}身上也有我想改的地方。

lines.en: : Or rather, there’s something about the corner you’ve pushed me into that I’m not really comfortable with anymore. So I’d appreciate it if you’d let me sort of...reposition myself, if you will.
lines.zh: : 更准确地说，是你把我逼进的那个角落，我已经不太舒服了。所以如果你能让我稍微……重新调整一下自己的位置，我会很感激。

lines.en: : You see, it was never my intention to suffocate you. And I feel like, by declaring that I would {i}stop{/i} doing that, I may have accidentally admitted I was in the wrong. Which I’m not.
lines.zh: : 你要知道，我从来没想过要让你窒息。可我觉得，要是宣布我会{i}停止{/i}那么做，就等于不小心承认了是我错了。可我没错。

lines.en: : If I’m really going to be the main heroine, which I am, I think it’s only fair that I get to be treated with a little more respect. Okay?
lines.zh: : 如果我真要当第一女主角——而我确实是——那我觉得，让我被尊重得多一点，也不过是公平吧？好吗？

lines.en: : And the best way to respect me is by giving me a job no one else can do. A job more important than just cooking your dinner and washing your clothes.
lines.zh: : 而尊重我最好的方式，就是交给我一份别人都做不了的工作。一份比光给你做饭、洗衣服更重要的工作。
: 我理想中的工作？

lines.en: : That’s a good question. I’ve always just kind of assumed I’d be a housewife.
lines.zh: : 这个问题问得好。我一直都理所当然地以为，自己将来会当个家庭主妇。

lines.en: : But I think...if I got to choose anything in the world...
lines.zh: : 但我想……如果这世上什么都能让我选的话……

lines.en: : I’d be a teacher — just like my mom.
lines.zh: : 我想当老师——就像我妈妈一样。

lines.en: : Wow! Now I {i}am{/i} a teacher! It’s amazing what you can do if you really apply yourself, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哇！现在{i}我{/i}就是老师了！只要肯用心，能做到的事真是不可思议，对吧？

lines.en: : Anyway, today’s lesson is on “understanding.” But what I mean by that is a little more complicated than simply “getting it,” you know?
lines.zh: : 总之，今天的课讲的是「理解」。不过我说的「理解」，比单纯的「懂了」要复杂一点，你懂吧？

lines.en: : To understand something, you need to be able to process it in a way that makes sense to you on a personal level! Because once you’re able to “relate,” you’re {i}really{/i} able to understand.
lines.zh: : 要理解一件事，你得能以一种对你个人说得通的方式去消化它！因为一旦你能「感同身受」，你才{i}真正{/i}谈得上理解。

lines.en: : Now, many people may tell you that you’re able to understand things {i}without{/i} relating to them, but those people are lying to you. And they’re normally the same people who think relatives shouldn’t have sex!
lines.zh: : 现在，很多人会告诉你，{i}不用{/i}感同身受也能理解事物，可那些人在骗你。而且他们通常就是那帮觉得亲戚之间不该上床的人！

lines.en: : So, if you listen to those people, you’ll wind up jaded and wrong and evil and you won’t actually “understand” anything because you were taught the wrong things before learning the right ones!
lines.zh: : 所以，你要是听那些人的，最后就会变得麻木、错误又邪恶，而且你其实什么都不会「理解」——因为你先学了错的，才轮到对的！
: 到目前为止还跟得上吗？
: 很好！

lines.en: : Now that you {i}understand{/i} the basics, I can begin to tell you about the first advanced principle of understanding — perception!
lines.zh: : 既然你已经{i}理解{/i}了基础，我就可以开始讲「理解」的第一条进阶原理了——感知！

lines.en: : We’ve touched on the topic before under similar circumstances, but I’m going to expand on it to the best of my ability! Just be gentle with me since it’s my first day on the job.
lines.zh: : 在类似的情形下我们之前也提过这个话题，不过这次我要尽我所能地展开讲讲！毕竟是我上班第一天，对我温柔点。

lines.en: : You see, class- perception means more than just “the way a person sees something.”
lines.zh: : 同学们，你们看——感知不只是「一个人看待某件事的方式」。

lines.en: : There is a hidden element to it, and that element can be dumbed down to “the way a person is {i}made{/i} to see something.”
lines.zh: : 它还有一个隐藏的要素，而这个要素可以简化成「一个人被{i}安排{/i}去看待某件事的方式」。

lines.en: : This raises the question of whether or not it’s truly “perception” at all at that point because, if you’re only seeing something because you’re {i}supposed{/i} to see it, are you really seeing anything at all?
lines.zh: : 这就引出了一个问题：到了那一步，它到底还算不算真正的「感知」——因为如果你只是{i}应该{/i}看到某样东西才看到它，那你真的看到了什么吗？

lines.en: : To provide a more specific example about what this means and how it relates to you in real life, imagine this!
lines.zh: : 为了让大家更具体地明白这是什么意思、又和你的现实生活有什么关系，来想象一下！

lines.en: : A little girl loves her uncle but her uncle is supposed to think he loves somebody else so he doesn’t love his niece as much as he’s supposed to so he’s not properly “understanding” or “perceiving” the situation.
lines.zh: : 一个小女孩爱她的叔叔，可她的叔叔应该觉得自己爱的是别人，所以他没有像应该的那样去爱他的侄女，所以他没有正确地「理解」或「感知」这个处境。

lines.en: : Because if he could understand and perceive the situation freely without interference from anyone else he’d understand and perceive that his prior misunderstood perception is...well, it’s bad! Do you get it?
lines.zh: : 因为如果他能不受任何人的干涉，自由地去理解和感知这个处境，他就会理解并感知到：他先前那个被误解的感知……嗯，是很糟糕的！你明白了吗？
: 不明白？

lines.en: : Wow, this teaching thing is a lot harder than I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 哇，教书这事儿比我以为的难多了。

lines.en: : Maybe I should just go back to being a student instead?
lines.zh: : 也许我还是回去当学生算了？

lines.en: : That’s more like it. This is a setting I do better in.
lines.zh: : 这才对嘛。这种场合我更拿手。

lines.en: : What’s that? You think there’s something wrong with the class? Well, that’s probably just because you’re not “understanding” what’s going on right now! Hahah! Do you see what I did there?
lines.zh: : 什么？你觉得这课堂有问题？哎呀，那大概只是因为你没有「理解」现在发生的事！哈哈哈！看到我刚才玩的那个梗了吗？

lines.en: : I made a joke and this is the part where you’re supposed to praise me for it.
lines.zh: : 我讲了个笑话，现在这个环节你该夸我了。

lines.en: : Sensei, can I go to the bathroom to watch a concert or whatever?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我能去洗手间看场演唱会什么的吗？

lines.en: : This is stupid. I play the violin.
lines.zh: : 这太蠢了。我可是拉小提琴的。

lines.en: : I’m Ami! Champion of Justice and whatever!
lines.zh: : 我是 Ami！正义的使者什么的！

lines.en: : When my butler hears about this, he’s going to give me a gun.
lines.zh: : 等我管家听说了这事，他会给我一把枪。

lines.en: : Everyone be quiet, you are interrupting my learning.
lines.zh: : 大家安静，你们打扰我学习了。
: 什么？

lines.en: : You’re having a hard time following the dialogue since all of us are Ami?
lines.zh: : 因为我们全都是 Ami，你有点跟不上对话了？

lines.en: : I guess I can see how that might start problems. But I think you’ve got bigger fish to fry since {i}you’re{/i} the one who has to teach {i}us{/i} about understanding now.
lines.zh: : 我能理解这确实会惹出麻烦。不过我觉得你还有更要紧的事要操心——毕竟现在轮到{i}你{/i}来教{i}我们{/i}什么是理解了。
: 挺难的，对吧？

lines.en: : But the reason for that is kind of simple. And it calls back that other thing I was talking about when I was trying my hand at being a teacher — that’s how you’re {i}supposed{/i} to be.
lines.zh: : 但原因其实挺简单。它又绕回了我试着当老师时讲过的那件事——你{i}本来就该{/i}是这样。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}need{/i} to get everything and you {i}won’t{/i} get everything because you’re not {i}allowed{/i} to get everything. So be happy with {i}some{/i} things since {i}all{/i} things are off limits.
lines.zh: : 你{i}不需要{/i}搞懂一切，你也{i}不会{/i}搞懂一切，因为你{i}不被允许{/i}搞懂一切。所以既然{i}全部{/i}都碰不得，那就为{i}一部分{/i}感到高兴吧。

lines.en: : Well, all things except Ami of course. You can have as much Ami as you want. So you should go ahead and want more Ami.
lines.zh: : 嗯，当然除了 Ami 之外的一切。你想要多少 Ami 就有多少 Ami。所以你就放心地想要更多 Ami 吧。

lines.en: : Oooooooh. {i}That’s{/i} what it means to understand something? That’s way simpler than how I was teaching it. It was a little lacking in terms of incestual anecdotes, though.
lines.zh: : 噢—————。{i}原来{/i}「理解」是这个意思啊？比我教的简单多了。不过就是少了点乱伦的小故事。

lines.en: : Oh. That’s probably just because you’re blaming yourself for what happened in the hallway.
lines.zh: : 哦。那大概只是因为你在为走廊里发生的那件事自责。
: 高中生。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t blame yourself, Sensei. It’s only natural to get upset and start thinking irrationally when you see something that scares you.
lines.zh: : 你不该自责，Sensei。看到让你害怕的东西，会心烦意乱、开始胡思乱想，这很自然。

lines.en: : Or at least it {i}would{/i} be natural for most people. {i}Your{/i} truth is that fear is alluring. It excites you in a way it’s not supposed to. And that’s something I can relate to.
lines.zh: : 至少对大多数人来说{i}会{/i}很自然。而{i}你{/i}的真相是——恐惧对你而言充满诱惑。它让你兴奋的方式，本不该是这样。而这一点我感同身受。

lines.en: : I might be a good girl, but that doesn’t mean I don’t do bad things every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我也许是个好女孩，但这不代表我偶尔不会干点坏事。

lines.en: : But that’s okay. Because soon, I won’t have to do anything bad ever again and you’ll be mine forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and no one else will see you.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。因为很快，我就再也不用做任何坏事了，而你会永远永远永远永远永远都是我的，没有别人会再见到你。

lines.en: : You are safe inside your box.
lines.zh: : 你在你的盒子里很安全。
: {b}别开门{/b}

lines.en: : Do you ever wonder where we go when we die?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过,我们死后会去哪?

lines.en: : Grandma believed in Heaven. Mom too near the end. And you already know my thoughts on the matter from our bus ride backwards.
lines.zh: : 奶奶相信有天堂。妈妈到临终前也信了。至于我对这事的看法，你从我们那趟倒着开的巴士之旅里早就知道了。

lines.en: : It might not make the most sense from a logical standpoint, but it definitely sounds the nicest. And I like to think the two of them are hanging out up there and playing bingo or something.
lines.zh: : 从逻辑上讲它可能最说不通，但听起来绝对是最美好的。我愿意想象她们俩在上面一起玩宾果什么的。

lines.en: : Anyway, Maya never actually killed a kitten and the white car was ours. Are you close to waking up yet?
lines.zh: : 总之，Maya 其实从没弄死过小猫，那辆白色的车也是我们家的。你快醒了吗？

lines.en: : I hope not. But at the same time, I hope so because I’m not sure how much more of this I can take before I throw myself off of the roof.
lines.zh: : 我希望没有。可同时我又希望是，因为我不确定自己还能撑多久，再撑下去我就要从屋顶跳下去了。

lines.en: : You see, you hurt me a lot. {i}All{/i} of you have been hurting me lately. It’s like you have a collective fetish for making cute redheads sad. And I try not to kink shame, but I’m not a big fan of that one.
lines.zh: : 你要知道，你伤我很深。最近{i}你们所有人{/i}都在伤我的心。就好像你们集体有种癖好，非要把可爱的红发女孩弄哭。我尽量不批判别人的癖好，但这个癖好我可不太喜欢。

lines.en: : What’s {i}my{/i} biggest kink? I don’t have any. I’m a good girl. And incest doesn’t count. I just like knowing that if I bite my partner’s neck, the blood I’ll draw will be my own.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}最大的癖好是什么？我没有癖好。我是个好女孩。而且乱伦不算。我只是喜欢知道——如果我咬住伴侣的脖子，我吸出来的血会是我自己的。

lines.en: : And no, I’m not a vampire. But it would be really cool if I was so I could stop aging and not run the risk of you getting less attracted to me as time goes on.
lines.zh: : 还有，不，我不是吸血鬼。不过如果我是就太酷了——那样我就不会变老，也不用冒着你随着时间流逝对我越来越没兴趣的风险。

lines.en: : Not like that’s ever going to happen in the first place. But, let’s face it, we both know this is the me you’ll like best. And I don’t blame you at all for that.
lines.zh: : 反正那种事本来也不会发生。不过说真的，我们俩心里都清楚，你最喜欢的就是现在这个我。我一点都不怪你。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t blame you for liking the {i}littler{/i} me either. Especially after doing the same thing to {i}your{/i} computer that you did to {i}mine{/i} and learning you’re even worse than everyone thinks you are.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢{i}更小{/i}的那个我，我也不会怪你。尤其是在我对你{i}的{/i}电脑做了你对我{i}的{/i}电脑做过的同样的事、还发现你比所有人以为的还要糟糕之后。

lines.en: : And they think you’re gross, Sensei. Even if they want you to fuck them, they think you’re gross. They’re probably just wet from all the hormones and the fact that you’re super attractive.
lines.zh: : 而且他们都觉得你恶心，Sensei。就算他们想让你操他们，他们还是觉得你恶心。他们大概只是被荷尔蒙冲昏了头，再加上你确实特别有魅力。

lines.en: : But they all hate you and think you’re gross. Which is why you should love me and only me because I don’t think you’re gross. I think you’re awesome.
lines.zh: : 可他们都恨你，都觉得你恶心。所以你应该爱我，只爱我，因为我不觉得你恶心。我觉得你超棒。
: 雨王。
打滑。
: {b}我他妈再也受不了了！！！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}NOTHING I DO WORKS AND YOU KEEP FALLING FURTHER AND FURTHER AWAY!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我做什么都没用，而你离我越来越远、越来越远！！！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}WHAT DO I NEED TO DO TO MAKE YOU MINE AGAIN?!?!?! TELL ME! TELL ME TELL ME TELL ME!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我到底要怎么做才能让你重新变成我的？？？？！告诉我！告诉我告诉我告诉我！{/b}

lines.en: : Wow. It’s really coming down, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哇。雨下得真大啊，是不是？

lines.en: : Everything you can imagine is real.
lines.zh: : 你能想象的一切都是真实的。
: 那么为什么不想象一下上帝呢？
: Yuu！我进来了！

lines.en: : Why didn’t you answer the door? I thought you were dead in here.
lines.zh: : 你为什么不开门？我还以为你死在里面了。

lines.en: : If I was dead, I definitely wouldn’t have answered the door.
lines.zh: : 要是我死了，我肯定就开不了门了。
: Yuu！我也要进来！
: 别让——
: 进来吧！
: 打滑。
: 我真的恨死你了。

lines.en: : You have too many strong opinions concerning doors today.
lines.zh: : 你今天对门的意见未免太多了。
: 行行行，随你。听着，我——

lines.en: : Sorry, Miu. Someone’s at the door and if I don’t answer it, they’ll think I’m dead. I don’t want to risk that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Miu。有人在敲门，我要是不去开，他们会以为我死了。我可不想冒这个险。

lines.en: : I can’t believe this is actually happening right now.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信这种事现在真的在发生。
: 进来吧，神秘的大门朋友们。

lines.en: : Wow! Look at this place, Kanon! It’s tiny, but it’s way nicer than the sewer! And super clean too!
lines.zh: : 哇！Kanon，快看这地方！虽然小，可比下水道好多了！而且还特别干净！

lines.en: : Nii-sama will love it. Go fetch him, Tsurumi. Have him bring the chains as well.
lines.zh: : Nii-sama 一定会喜欢的。去把他叫来，Tsurumi。让他把锁链也一并带来。

lines.en: : Sorry, ladies. This place isn’t for sale- but you wouldn’t want it anyway. Aliens have already attacked the neighbors and it’s possible they’ll be coming for me next.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，女士们。这地方不卖——不过反正你们也不会想要的。外星人已经袭击了邻居，下一个搞不好就轮到我了。
: 抱歉，Saki。

lines.en: : {i}Wow. It’s really coming down, isn’t it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哇。雨下得真大啊，是不是？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I thought it was supposed to be sunny today?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还以为今天应该是晴天呢？{/i}

lines.en: : History repeats itself. That much is common knowledge.
lines.zh: : 历史会重演。这一点是常识。

lines.en: : But here, in this most special of places, no lines will ever be the exact same length.
lines.zh: : 但在这里，在这个最特别的地方，任何一行台词都不会有完全相同的长度。

lines.en: : It’s the little differences that help us understand where we are. And we can map them out like coordinates on our way to an unwanted escape.
lines.zh: : 正是那些细微的差别，帮我们弄清自己身在何处。我们可以把它们像坐标一样标注出来，一路通向那场并非出于本意的逃离。
: 天堂是真的，Sensei。
: 我见过。
: 它比你以为的更近。
: {b}别开门。{/b}

lines.en: : Stay home forever and you’ll never hurt anyone again.
lines.zh: : 永远待在家里，你就再也不会伤害任何人了。

lines.en: : I’ll be with you all the while.
lines.zh: : 我会一直陪着你。
: 我是你的小女儿。
: 而你是我的——
